{{Quote|I am Barrarrao, the leader of the colony.|Barrarro|<ref name="From the Trees">{{LivingForce|From the Trees}}</ref>}}
'''Barrarro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]], who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Barrarro was the leader of [[Kiirloor]], a Wookiee settlement that was located on Cularin, near to [[Cloud Mountain]]. During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[heroes of Cularin]] traveled to Kiirloor and Barrarro greeted them on their arrival there.
